title: Unified Handler Profile Schema
description: JSON Schema for UnifiedHandler base and feature profiles. Validates both Base (Full/Derived) and Feature YAML files under resources/builtin_profiles/.

name.description: Unique profile identifier. Used as the filename stem (without .yml) and referenced in config.yml under base_handler or features.

version.description: SemVer-like version string (e.g. '1.0.0'). Used by the sync-on-load mechanism to detect builtin updates; compared lexicographically by tuple.

changelog.description: Human-readable changelog shown in the [WARNING] update-available message when a builtin profile has a newer version.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this profile does.

extends.description: Parent handler name. Only valid in base profiles. The profile inherits all behaviour from the parent MCDR handler and only overrides the fields listed below. Examples: 'forge_handler', 'bukkit_handler', 'velocity_handler', 'vanilla_handler'. When omitted, the profile is a Full Profile built from BasicHandler (e.g. bedrock_bds).

allOf.$comment: If extends is present, this is a derived base profile (base/ only, not features/).

regex_substitutions.title: Regex Substitutions
regex_substitutions.description: Ordered list of regex → replacement substitutions.

replacement.description: Replacement string. Supports backslash group references (e.g. \1). Defaults to ''.

stop_on_match.description: If true, stop processing further substitutions after this one matches. Default: false.

log_format.title: Log Format
log_format.description: Defines how server log lines are parsed into structured fields. Used as the primary parser in full_profile mode, or as an exception-fallback in wrapper mode.

pattern.description: A single regex with named capture groups. Required groups: hour, min, sec, logging, content.

patterns.description: Multiple regex patterns tried in order. First match wins. Each must have the named groups: hour, min, sec, logging, content.

pre_parse.title: Pre-parse Processing
pre_parse.description: Text transformations applied to every stdout line BEFORE the base handler parses it.

strip_ansi.description: Strip ANSI escape sequences (e.g. colour codes) from the line.

strip_control_chars.description: Strip ASCII control characters (ord < 0x20) from the line.

control_chars_except.description: Characters to KEEP when strip_control_chars is true. Each element is a single character string.

regex_substitutions.description: Ordered list of regex → replacement substitutions applied to the raw text. Set stop_on_match: true to prevent further substitutions after a match.

player_message.title: Player Message Detection
player_message.description: Regex patterns that identify a log line as a player chat message and extract the player name + message content.

patterns.description: Ordered list of regex patterns. Must contain named capture group 'name'. Optional named group 'message' replaces info.content when matched. First match wins.

name_validation.description: Regex that extracted player names must fullmatch to be considered valid. Default: '[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,16}'.

quote_player_names.description: Wrap extracted player names in double quotes. Required for Bedrock BDS where player names can contain spaces.

ignore_content_prefixes.description: If info.content starts with any of these prefixes, the content is cleared to empty string (preventing accidental command execution via chat).

extra_fields.description: Mapping from regex capture group names to Info attribute names. When a player_message pattern matches, the named groups are extracted and attached as dynamic attributes on the Info object. Example: {"subserver": "subserver"} sets info.subserver = matched['subserver'].

regex_substitutions.description: Ordered list of regex → replacement substitutions applied to the player message content after detection. Set stop_on_match: true to prevent subsequent substitutions from undoing a match.

parse_server_stdout.title: Pseudo Players
parse_server_stdout.description: Virtual / pseudo player definitions — map specific log patterns to special player names (e.g. command blocks, functions, sub-servers).

pseudo_players.description: Each entry defines a pattern → player_name mapping.

pattern.description: Python regex. Optional named group 'message' replaces info.content on match.

player_name.description: Virtual player name assigned to info.player on match. Use double-quote wrapping for names with spaces (e.g. '"!commandblock"').

join_leave.title: Join / Leave Detection
join_leave.description: Regex patterns for detecting player join and leave events. Patterns must contain the named capture group 'name'.

patterns.description: Ordered list of regex patterns. Must contain named group 'name'. In full_profile mode these are the ONLY patterns; in wrapper mode they supplement the base handler's detection.

server_version.title: Server Version Detection
server_version.description: Pattern to extract the server version string from a log line.

server_address.title: Server Address Detection
server_address.description: Pattern to extract the server IP and port from a log line.

pattern.description: Regex with named groups 'port' (required) and 'ip' (optional, defaults to '127.0.0.1').

detection_mode.description: 'first_only' = only the first matching line is used (BDS outputs IPv4 twice). 'all' = every match re-fires. Default: 'all'.

server_startup_done.title: Startup Complete Detection
server_startup_done.description: Patterns that indicate the server has finished starting up.

patterns.description: List of regex patterns. A fullmatch signals that startup is complete.

rcon_started.title: RCON Started Detection
rcon_started.description: Pattern for detecting when the RCON server is ready, or a flag to disable RCON detection entirely.

enabled.description: Set to false to always return False from test_rcon_started (e.g. Bedrock BDS has no RCON). When omitted or true, the pattern field is used.

pattern.description: Regex that fullmatches a line indicating RCON is ready.

server_stopping.title: Server Stopping Detection
server_stopping.description: Patterns that indicate the server is beginning to stop.

patterns.description: List of regex patterns. A fullmatch signals that the server is stopping.

commands.title: Server Commands
commands.description: Templates for server control commands (stop, tell/send message, broadcast).

stop.description: Command sent to the server console to stop the server gracefully. Default: 'stop'.

send_message.description: Template for sending a message to a specific player.

template.description: Template string. {target} is replaced with the player name, {message} with the formatted message. Example: 'tellraw {target} {message}'.

wrap_with_execute.description: Optional wrapper for bedrock_rawtext support on older BDS versions.

min_version.description: Minimum server version that does NOT need wrapping. Below this, the outer template is used.

template.description: Wrapper template. Example: 'execute at @p run tellraw {target} {message}'.

broadcast.description: Template for broadcasting a message to all players. {message} is replaced with the formatted message.

message_format.description: Message serialization format. 'java_json' uses RTextBase.to_json_str() (default). 'bedrock_rawtext' uses {'rawtext': [...]} format for BDS.
